newsitem.title: ANGOLA: NEW OIL FIND OFF ANGOLA, COMPANY OFFICIAL SAYS.
newsitem.headline: NEW OIL FIND OFF ANGOLA, COMPANY OFFICIAL SAYS.

text.p: A potentially large oil reserve has been found off the coast of Angola, an oil company official said on Monday.
"There has been a new discovery in Block 17," the oil company official involved in Block 17, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
"The initial indications are that it is a very big field."
Oil industry analysts in Luanda also confirmed that a new find had been made in the block -- as the divisions of Angola's coastal waters are known.
"This was in the Dalia field in Block 17," said one analyst. "There is some big excitement about it but it is too early to say for sure how big it is."

Elf Exploration, a joint venture between the French oil company Elf Aquitaine and the Angolan state oil company Sonangol, is the operator of the Block 17 drilling licence and holds a 35 percent stake in the block.
Other partners in Block 17 are Esso Exploration Angola, BP Exploration (Angola), Den Norske Stats Oljeselkskap ASA (Statoil), Norsk Hydro and Fina Exploration M.B.V.
Elf officials in Luanda had no comment on the possible discovery. One said only, "We are preparing a press release which will be ready in a few days.
